description: This file contains implementation for handling external interrupts on GPIO pins for a hardware platform. It sets up configuration structures, manages enabling external interrupts on specific pins, and provides functions to start the external interrupt system.

methods.name: getExtMode
methods.description: Returns the external mode configuration based on the GPIO port.

methods.name: enableExti
methods.description: Enables external interrupt on a specified pin with mode and callback.

methods.name: myExtStart
methods.description: Starts the external interrupt system with the configured settings.
